audit.whatIsWrong: Chronoshift (R) makes its target untargetable and dodges burst/executes, but no field tells you to wait it out rather than dumping your combo into it.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags this as applicable-but-unstated: committing everything into a Chronoshift target wastes cooldowns for nothing.
audit.corrected: Folded into 'ahead' (in-scope per template sweep, was generic filler) so the snowball advice states the real counterplay.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, passive-auto, bank the Q visibly — the chip is free and the threat governs.
edits.after: He has no dash — a landed Q on his squishy frame is a kill threat lvls 1-5, so bank it for the step-up instead of poking it away.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown until the hook learns the rhythm — the binding is the lane's law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Chronoshift makes him untargetable through your commit — dumping your full combo into a glowing Zilean burns cooldowns on nothing; wait the revive out instead.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. It writes your spacing rules. - W Prismatic Barrier is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Zilean Chronoshift (R): 60-120s cd — the revive undoes your kill; force it early or swap focus once it glows on his target. - His Time Bomb (Q) is 8-10s — a single bomb can't stun, so lvls 1-5 he can't punish your poke. - Your W is 10-12s — save it for the double-bomb stun chain.

edits.before: Ahead, own the geometry: chip Zilean's duo per wave and laser the recovery roots.
edits.after: Ahead, don't dump your combo into Chronoshift — wait the untargetable window out, then finish the target once the revive expires.
